title: Outside Laboratory Schedule, Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Outside Laboratory Schedule

For each service of Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services, whether a stone is sent to an outside laboratory, which laboratories the service accepts, whether the laboratory's fee is passed on to the customer and whether the stone travels to the laboratory under insurance are as follows.

| Service | Stone sent to an outside laboratory | Laboratories accepted | Laboratory fee passed on to the customer | Stone travels under insurance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | No | None | No | No |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | No | None | No | No |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | No | None | No | No |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | No | None | No | No |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | Yes | GIA, AGS, IGI, SSEF, GUB | Yes | Yes |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | Yes | GIA, AGS | Yes | Yes |

## Schedule notes

- The laboratories column lists the outside laboratories the service will send a stone to, by laboratory code; a service with no laboratory listed sends nothing out.
- Where the fee column reads Yes, the outside laboratory's fee is passed on to the customer; where it reads No, no laboratory fee reaches the customer under that service.
- Where the insurance column reads Yes, the stone travels to the laboratory under insurance.

## Laboratories by service, read the other way

| Laboratory | Services that accept it |
|---|---|
| GIA | Certified Gemological Laboratory Report; Collection Portfolio Appraisal |
| AGS | Certified Gemological Laboratory Report; Collection Portfolio Appraisal |
| IGI | Certified Gemological Laboratory Report only |
| SSEF | Certified Gemological Laboratory Report only |
| GUB | Certified Gemological Laboratory Report only |

A stone on a Collection Portfolio Appraisal goes only to GIA or AGS; a stone on a Certified Gemological Laboratory Report may go to any of the five laboratories listed against that service.
